main_text.p: Tu, cum ה redundante, plur. אַנַּחְתּוֹן Vos, Dan.2, efiq, generis communis. Unde patet, in Hebræo אַתָּה dages poni loco Nun, & esse ab אָנִי.
אֲנַכִּי Paulo ante in אֲנִי positum.
אֶתְאוֹנַן Hithpahel Lamentari, Plangere, Quiritari. Num.11.1.Thren. 3.39.
אוֹן m. Planctus, Mæror, Luctus: plur. אוֹנִים.
אַנִּי Chald. Illi, Ifti, fæm. אַנִּיָּא Illæ, Ifta, Nun in fine plurali servit.
אֲנַס Adegit, Coegit, Exegit, Urfit, Presfit. Chald. אָנַס Premens, Dan.4.6.
אָנַף Irafci. Hithpahel הִתְאַנַּף Iratum se exhibere vel Ostendere, Irâ commoveri.
אַף m. Ira: metonymicè, Vultus, Facies tanquam ira index, & Synecdochicè, Nasus: Duale אַפַּיִם Ira, Facies, Vultus, Nares.
אַנְפִּין Chal. Facies, Vultus: cum Affixo, אַנְפּוֹהִי Faciem suam, Dan. 4.46: hinc liquet in Hebræo אַף esse elisum Nun, cujus loco succedit dagesch, quando à fine syllabâ augetur.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free; Hebrew forms are reproduced as best legible from the scan, with vowel points partly uncertain. Several vowel points and dagesh marks are doubtful. The Hebrew running head and footer "אנ" / "אנף" are approximate.
